Walk-to-path lemma with a bound and with u = v allowed: from any walk w_0,...,w_k (k >= 0) from u to v one obtains a path from u to v of length at most k whose vertices all occur in the walk. Proof by strong induction on k, deleting the block between two equal vertices.
